The Suppression Gate: A Line-Scoped Directive an Edit Adds Is Refused, and Existing Debt Never Blocks
The Gate Ledger: One Path for Writer and Reader, and the Fail-Fast Order
The Warrant Transcriber: One Entry per Unwarranted Test, Keyed by File and Name, and a Brace Refused
The Hook Argv Contract: Any Argument Refused by Name Before the Payload Is Read, One Declared Mode
The Inbound-Asks Context Hook: Unclaimed Peer Asks Surfaced Once, a Tool That Could Not Run Said and Never Read as Nothing, and No Refusal
The Worktree Venv Fallback: a Linked Worktree Borrows the Main Tree Venv for the Same Distribution, Tools Only
The Nemik-Check Context Hook: This Repo's Shape Findings Surfaced Once, a Reader That Could Not Run Said and Never Read as Clean, and No Refusal
The Post-Commit: the Shared Hook Writes the Advisory Marker and Reports a Failed Amend and Never Pushes, the Repo Hook Pushes and Names Why a Push Stopped
The Shared Prepare-Commit-Msg: the Gate Report Folded Into the Message Once, Every Failure Reported Rather Than Swallowed, and No Push
The Host Facts: the zram Ceiling and the Tick Lock Read as Facts, Absent When Unreadable and Never Zeros or Empty
The Tick-Stop Guard: a Held Fresh Host Lock Blocks the Stop Once and Never Twice, a Stale or Unreadable One Blocks Nothing
The Tick Gate: a Loop Prompt That Cannot Run Is Refused Before It Costs a Turn, Every Other Prompt Passes Untouched, and a Fact That Cannot Be Read Blocks Nothing

The After-Compaction Context: the Project's Pointers to Its Durable State and the Live Host Facts Come Back After a Compact Only, a Missing Notes File Is Said Not Skipped, and a Session Start Is Never Blocked

The Tick-Lock Release: a Fresh Host Lock Is Released at Session End Through the One Writer, a Stale or Unreadable One Is Left Alone, and a Writer That Cannot Be Found or Fails Is Said and the Lock Left Held
The Python Edit Gate by Hand: the Unclipped Verdict on One File, Not-Checked Is Never Clean, and a File in No Project Is Not Checked Though the Hook Would Admit It
The Gate's Verdict as a Ledger: Findings Counted per File From the Report's Own Markers, a Refusal Never Zero, and a File No Checker Judged Never Clean

The Build-Failure Report: a Failed Build's Cause Read From BuildBuddy by Invocation Id and Fed Back on Exit 2, an Unreadable Log or Missing Reader Stated With the Command, and a Failure That Ran No Build Left Alone
The Closure Advisory: Unclean Imports Named From Debtplan's Graph With Their Findings, and Silence When No Ledger, Planner or Debt Is There
The Closure Hook: an Edited Python File's Unclean Imports Added as Context After the Edit, Never a Refusal, and Anything Else Says Nothing
The Gate's Verdict on Every Changed File: Names From Git's Status, a Rename's Origin and a Deletion Skipped, and One Exit That a Refusal Never Loses to a Clean Run
The Commit Kata: a Commit's Outcome Read From HEAD and Stated in One Last Line (Committed, Refused, or Not Committed), No Tracked Path Committing Nothing, and a Rewritten Lock Riding Along
The Hooks Preflight: the Venv Rebuilt Before the Changed-Files Verdict, and a Rebuild That Cannot Run Is Not Checked, Never Clean
The Read Guard: an Unbounded Whole-File Read of an Oversized File Is Denied With the Cheaper Reads Named, a Bounded or Rendered or Unsizable One Is Admitted, and an Unarmed Guard Says Nothing
The Bazel Admission: Heavy Commands Wait on Zram Headroom and a Memory Lease, Light Ones Run Untouched, a Full Zram Is Refused After a Bounded Wait, and What Cannot Be Read Blocks Nothing
The Format Mode: The Project's Own Formatter Applied to One File, Written Only When It Changes, and a File in No Project Never Reads as Clean
The Snapshot: An Immutable Tree at One Fixed Namespaced Path, Locked Against a Second Writer, Updated by Its Difference, and Never the Real Index
The Prune Cross-Check: What --prune Would Drop Must Equal the Pairing Check's Orphan Set, a Disagreement or a Missing Checker Refuses Before Anything Is Written, and --dry-run Shows It
The Section Agreement in the Pairing Check: Warrant Sections Against Rubric Rows, Named Both Ways, a Lost Tab or Title Caught Before Commit
The Commit Launcher: A Stable Path to mikemol-commit That Hands Every Argument Through and Refuses, Naming the Repair, When the Built Venv or Its Script Is Absent

Scratch Land: a Worktree's Change Reaches the Main Tree Whole or Not at All, Refusing on a Dirty Path, a Symlink or No Change
Commit Span: One Commit Is Three Spans in One Trace, the Phases Meet at the Lease, and a Refusal Reads as an Error
Commit Counts: Queued and In-Flight Commits Are Counted From a Crash-Safe Map, and a Killed Commit or a Recycled Pid Is Not Counted
Commit Gauge: Each Transition Starts Two Absolute Gauges and Never Raises Into the Commit
Stack Snapshot: A File Frozen at Submit Keeps Its Bytes Whatever the Working Tree Does Next, and HEAD Moving Keeps Both Changes
Stack Freeze: The Snapshot Taken at Submit Reaches the Run, and Every Fallback Freezes Now Rather Than Reading the Tree Late
Gate Environment: The Commit Gate Does Not See the Submitter's MIKEMOL_ Variables Except the Ones It Reads, and Everything Else Passes Untouched
Stack Manifest Drift: A Stack Entry Is Compared With Its Card's Declared Manifest and Drift Is Reported, Never Refused
Codon Probe: One File Is Compiled With the Pinned Compiler, Fetched and Hash-Verified on First Use, and Nothing Unverified Is Unpacked
Undefined Builtins: A Builtin Name Codon 0.20.3 Does Not Define Is Flagged Where It Is Read, Except a Name the Module Binds and the Two Decorators Codon Allows
Commit Turns: Queued Commits Take the Lease in Submission Order, Each Waiting on the One Ahead, With No Deadline
Session Heartbeat: A Tool Call Leaves a Record, the Gaps Between Records Are Learned, and a Fault Never Fails the Tool
Hold Lift: A Hold on a Human Is Lifted by a Transcript Record of the Operator's Own Words Naming the Card, Read Again at Lift Time, and Never by a Stored Command
The Shared Queue Fixture: Nemik's Queue and Ledger Are Vendored Byte-for-Byte and Pinned by Git Blob Hash, So a Drift Fails the Copy and Not a Reader
Stack Trees: Each Entry of a Stack Gets a Git Tree Sha at Submit From Its Frozen Bytes Over Head, Cumulative, Content-Addressed and Pinned Under a Ref, With Nothing in the Repo Moved

Stack Build Sources: A Stack Is Refused at Submit When a Frozen BUILD or .bzl File Names a Python Source That Neither HEAD Nor the Entry's Files Carry, and Never on a Glob, a Label or a Name It Cannot Read
Stack Import Order: A Stack Is Refused at Submit When a Frozen File Imports a Module Only a Later Entry Adds, and Never When the Name Is Not a File
A Session With No MIKEMOL_ENDPOINTS Still Names a Store Through the Host's File
The House Mypy Flag Set Is Complete, Ordered and Spelled as Mypy Takes It
Extra Mypy Flags Override a Project's Config for the Mypy Run Only
The Census Can Judge by the House Mypy Flags, and Only the Census
The Preflight Lints Every Distribution's Declared Defects Before a Stack Is Submitted
A Second Concurrent Subagent Is Refused Unless the Operator's Latest Words Authorise It
The Write Guard: A Shell Command That Writes Into the Project Past the Edit Bar Is Refused, and Writes Outside It, Reads and Streams Pass

The Merge Train: The Queue's Tip Tree Is Gated Once, a Green Tip Lands Every Submission Under It Naming the Tip as Its Gate, and a Red Tip Is Bisected, Its First Bad Submission Refused and the Rest Landed
Stack Pinned Trees: A Submitted Stack's Entries Get Cumulative Trees Pinned Under Refs and Recorded for a Presubmit, Released When the Run Ends, and a Failure Pins Nothing and Refuses Nothing
The Train Join: A Lease Holder Reads the Stacks Queued Behind It Back From the Ledger Alone, in Submit Order, and Leaves Out Any Whose Files Are Missing or Stale
The Gate Marks Each Stage It Begins in the Grammar the Span Reader Reads, So Where a Gate's Time Went Is Measured

The Train Drive: The Joined Tip Is Gated Once, a Red Is Bisected Over Group Boundaries, the Green Prefix Lands, the First Bad Stack Is Refused and Those Behind It Are Judged Anew, and a Stack That Cannot Be Built Is Dropped
The Train Verdict: A Joined Stack Finds the Verdict Its Leader Left, Prints It and Returns Its Code Without Taking the Lease, Once, and a Torn or Absent File Is No Verdict
The Train Lead: A Lease Holder Joins the Queued Stacks Behind It, Runs One Train, Prints Its Own Verdict and Leaves Each Follower Its Own, and Nobody Behind or the Switch Off Is No Train

The Train Telemetry: Each Train Is One Span of Its Own Family With Its Stacks Joined, Gates Run, Bisect Steps, Rounds, Landed, Refused and Dropped as Fields, Sent Only When Something Was Joined and Never Changing a Verdict
The Presubmit: The Gate's Own Bazel Test Planned Inside a Working-Tree Snapshot, in Its Own Namespace, With the Runner's Exit Code Passed Through
The Withdraw Mode: A Queued Submission Is Ended by Its Own Pid and Named, an In-Flight One Is Refused, and a Dead or Unknown Key Signals Nothing
The Refusing Stage: A REFUSED Line Names the Last Phase the Gate Began, From Its Marks, and Says Nothing When It Has None
The Gate's Withdraw Boundary: A Marker Keyed to the Submission Stops the Gate Between Phases With Exit 75 and Is Removed, and No Marker, an Unset Variable or Another Key's Marker Lets It Run
The Sibling Census: A Path Is a Reach Only When It Resolves Into Another Checkout, Not When It Stays in the Repo or Names the Repo Itself, and the Command Counts Tracked Files Only

The Sibling-Reach Ratchet: Per File, a Count Above Its Baseline or a New File With a Reach Is Refused Naming the Checkouts, a Paydown Is Slack, and the One Exempt Prefix Is Neither Counted Nor Refused

The Gate Trend: A Phase's Median and Median-Absolute-Deviation Spread Resist One Outlier, the Slope Is Seconds per Gate, and the Reader Takes the Gating Spans From the Trace Store Named by the Host's Endpoints File
The Commit Verdict Counter: One Bounded Sample per Printed Verdict, Labelled by Repo, Kind and Last Stage, Never Changing the Verdict
The Train Round Record: One Span and Two Samples per Round, with the Failed Checks and the Throttle the Gate Was Held To, Never Changing a Verdict
The Gated-Tree Trailer: An Isolated Commit Names the Tree Its Gate Ran On, in the Message's Own Trailer Block
The Stuck-Train Restart: Reads the Live Map, Refuses What It May Not Stop, Waits for the Group to Be Gone, Then Resubmits as One Stack

The Gate History Reader: A Step's Record Is Read off the Round Spans Newest First, a Round That Did Not Run a Step Is Not Evidence, the Streak Counts From the Newest Round, and the Report Lists the Failing First
The Train Alerts: A Red Streak Is N Reds and No Green in a Window, a Landing Gap Is the Newest COMMITTED Sample Past a Limit, and No Landing at All Is the Freshness Alert's Case
The Launcher Notice: A Bazel-Bin Venv Committing Another Repo Is Told to Install the Pin, the Repo's Own Venv and the Mtools Tree Are Not Noticed, and Silence Writes Nothing
The Commit Progress Witness: CPU of the Process Tree or Growth of Its Output Is Progress, a Run of Flat Looks Is a Stall, and an Unreadable Process Table Is Skipped
The Worktree Reaper's Classification: Held, Dirty, Unmerged, Gone and Clean-Equivalent in That Precedence, an Unknown Never Read as Clean, and Nothing Changed
The Follow Loop: A Pass on the File's Own Change and Never on Elapsed Time, a Held Pass Pausing and Passing Again, a Rotation or a Missing File Counting as a Change, and a Quiet File Only Sampled
The Follow Flag: Refused Without a File or With a Command, and Each Pass Shipping Only What Is New
The New Worktree: Not a Candidate Until an Earlier Run Has Listed It, Held Still Winning, a Missing Directory Judged at Once, and the Seen File the Only Thing Written

The Worktree Save: Dirty Work Kept With Its Untracked Files in a Commit Under refs/stash-reap, Unmerged Work Kept by Its Branch Tip, the Sha in the Name, a Clean or New Worktree Given No Ref, and Nothing Removed

The Worktree Removal: Only a Gone or Clean-Equivalent Worktree, by Its Exact Path, Without Force So Git Is the Last Gate, Held Read Again Just Before, and the Branches and Every Other Class Left Alone
The Failing-Step Classifier: New When It Never Failed in the Window, Intermittent When Some Rounds Were Red, Broken When Every One Was, Unknown With No History, and Only the Recent Rounds Counting
The Gate History Read From the Trace Store: No Answer Is None and Never an Empty History, So a Refusal Never Claims a Regression for Want of a Record

The Session Cache Gauges: Each Recent Session's Latest Turn as Gauges Labelled by Session and Model, the Series Count Capped by a Session Count, and a Count Gauge Sent on Every Run So a Dead Producer Is a Missing Series
Running a Command With Stdin To Completion: It Waits, So A Child That Fails Is Seen With Its Exit Code and Stderr, And A Missing Program Is 127 With A Note
The Submit-Time Mutant Lint Names The Dists A Stack Touches, Refuses A Missing Venv And A Failing Lint, And Is Silent Only When Every Declaration Plants
The Submit-Time Type Check Runs Only A Dist That Declares A Mypy Table, Refuses A Missing Venv And A Failing Or Silently Dead Mypy, And Keeps Its Cache Beside The Snapshot
